# Convert scene

## Customer decision-making travel

### Travel Chart

| Phase | Client issues | Key players | Common verification | Common observation indicators |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Problem awakening | Why is it inefficient and not always right? | Boss, head of business. | Diagnosis table, industry benchmark, ROI self-measured | Effective diagnostic completion rate |
| 2. Programme exploration | Buy single-point tools, change ERPs, or integrate them? | Operations + IT | Structure comparison, status system inventory, scene sorting | Proportion of programme participants |
| 3. Brand comparison | Why the current scheme? | Procurement, IT, responsible | Comparative matrix, industry case, integrated and safety materials | Rate of technical review pass |
| 4. Demonstration and trial | Can I run through the real process? | First-line users, business owners | Scenario presentation using client sample data | Core mission completion rate |
| 5. Business decision-making | Are total costs, risks and returns manageable? | Boss, finance, procurement | TCO/ROI, SLA, project plan, exit mechanism | Pilot contracting rate |
| 6. Sector pilots | Do users really use it and do indicators improve? | Project leader, first line | 14-90 days of pilot, weekly board, training | Activity, time savings, error rate |
| 7. Extending access | How to expand from one sector to the whole company? | IT, COO, departments | Main data governance, interface, authority and change management | Expansion of module rate, go-live cycle |
| 8. Continuation costs and recommendations | Is the value continuous and the service reliable? | Boss, buyer, user. | Quarterly operational reviews, value reports, road map | Continuation rate, net income retention, recommended rate |

### Critical experience nodes

| Matters | Information |
| --- | --- |
| First scene presentation | Whether to use the client ' s own processes and fields rather than the generic template; |
| First Data Import | Fast, accurate and roll-backable; |
| First-line employee week. | Whether operations are really reduced; |
| First time out. | Whether AI or process error can be explained, withdrawn and supported; |
| First month to manage the flash drive | Quantifiable business improvements; |
| First expansion module | Whether re-use of the platform would be easier than re-procurement of the new system. |
